faq.1.title: Why do I need WordPress maintenance services?
faq.1.description: WordPress maintenance is essential for keeping your website secure, fast, and functional. Regular updates, security monitoring, and performance optimization prevent security breaches, improve user experience, and ensure your site continues to work properly as WordPress and plugins evolve.
faq.2.title: What happens if my WordPress site gets hacked?
faq.2.description: If your WordPress site gets compromised, we provide immediate malware removal and security restoration services. Our monitoring system detects threats early, and our backup system ensures we can quickly restore your site to a clean state with minimal downtime.
faq.3.title: How often do you update WordPress sites?
faq.3.description: We perform WordPress core updates as soon as they're released and deemed stable. Plugin and theme updates are handled weekly or as needed. Critical security updates are applied immediately to ensure your site stays protected.
faq.4.title: Will updates break my website?
faq.4.description: We follow strict testing procedures before applying any updates. We create backups before each update and test functionality to minimize the risk of issues. If problems occur, we can quickly restore from backup and resolve any conflicts.
faq.5.title: How much do WordPress maintenance services cost?
faq.5.description: Our pricing depends on the number of websites you need maintained and the level of service required. We offer flexible plans starting from €7/month for basic maintenance up to €69/year for enterprise-level unlimited site management. All plans include essential security monitoring and updates.
faq.6.title: Do you provide backups for my WordPress site?
faq.6.description: Yes, all our maintenance plans include automated backups. Depending on your plan level, we provide daily, weekly, or monthly backups stored securely off-site. You can request backup restoration at any time, and we maintain backup history for easy recovery.
faq.7.title: What if I need help with my WordPress site?
faq.7.description: All our maintenance plans include expert support from our WordPress specialists. You can contact us via email, live chat, or our support portal. Higher-tier plans include priority support with faster response times and phone support options.
faq.8.title: Can you help optimize my WordPress site speed?
faq.8.description: Absolutely! Performance optimization is included in our Premium and Enterprise plans. We optimize images, implement caching, clean up databases, optimize code, and configure CDN services to ensure your WordPress site loads as quickly as possible for better user experience and SEO.

aboutUs.title: Why Choose Devora?
aboutUs.subTitle: About US
aboutUs.description2: Welcome to Devora, operated by Devora Systems, a U.S.-registered company based in Albuquerque, New Mexico. We are your trusted partner for comprehensive WordPress maintenance, security, and SEO optimization services. With years of experience managing WordPress websites for businesses across North America and Europe, we help organizations keep their online presence secure, fast, and always up to date.
aboutUs.description3: At Devora, our mission is to take the technical burden off your shoulders so you can focus on what you do best - running your business. We believe that every WordPress website deserves professional care and attention, regardless of its size or complexity. Our dedicated team of WordPress experts works around the clock to ensure your website runs smoothly.
aboutUs.description4: With extensive experience in WordPress development, security, and optimization, we have refined our processes to deliver reliable, professional maintenance services. Whether you need regular updates, security monitoring, performance optimization, or emergency support, our comprehensive maintenance packages are designed to meet your specific needs.
aboutUs.description5: At Devora, we are committed to being your long-term WordPress partner. Your website's success is our success, and we take pride in maintaining the backbone of your online presence. From small business websites to large enterprise platforms, we're here to ensure your WordPress site stays secure, fast, and functional.
aboutUs.description6: Devora Systems is committed to customer satisfaction, transparent billing, and the security of every website we manage. All online payments are processed by Stripe over an encrypted PCI-DSS-compliant connection; we never store full card numbers on our systems.
aboutUs.description7: Ready to secure and optimize your WordPress website? Contact us today to learn more about how Devora can be your trusted WordPress maintenance partner. We're excited to take care of your website so you can focus on your business.

refund.description1: This Refund Policy is issued by Devora Systems, doing business as Devora ('we,' 'our,' or 'us'), a company organized under the laws of the State of New Mexico, USA, with its principal place of business at 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE, STE R, Albuquerque, NM 87110. This policy is provided in addition to, and does not affect, any non-waivable statutory rights you may have under applicable law.

refund.description4: (a) Service not delivered: if a service you have paid for has not been provided, or has been materially defective and we have been unable to resolve the issue within a reasonable time after notification, you are entitled to a full refund.
refund.description5: (b) Right of withdrawal (consumers in the EU/UK): where applicable, consumers may withdraw from a contract within 14 days of purchase. If you have asked us to begin work during this period, we may deduct an amount proportional to the services already performed. Once the service has been fully performed with your express consent, the right of withdrawal is lost.
refund.description6: (c) Subscription cancellation: monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual subscriptions can be cancelled at any time and will not renew at the end of the current billing cycle. Fees already paid for the current billing cycle are non-refundable except as required by law or under sections (a) or (b) above.
refund.description8: Setup fees, one-off audits, custom development hours that have been delivered, and third-party costs incurred on your behalf (domain renewals, premium plugin licences, paid CDN or hosting credits, etc.) are non-refundable once the work has been carried out or the third-party fee has been paid.
refund.description10: Send a written refund request to contact@devorasystems.com within 14 days of the charge you are disputing. Include your full name, the email address used at checkout, the order or invoice number, the date of payment, and a clear description of the reason for the request. We will acknowledge your request within 2 business days.
refund.description12: We will assess each request on its merits and notify you of our decision by email within 10 business days of receiving all required information. Approved refunds are issued exclusively to the original payment method through our payment processor, Stripe, Inc. We do not refund to a different card, account, or payee. Refunds may not exceed the original amount actually charged.
refund.description14: Once approved, refunds are typically released by Stripe within 1 business day. The funds usually appear on your statement within 5 to 10 business days for credit and debit cards, and within 3 to 7 business days for SEPA or bank transfers, depending on your bank and country.
refund.description15: 6. Chargebacks: before initiating a chargeback with your card issuer or bank, please contact us in good faith at contact@devorasystems.com so we can attempt to resolve the matter directly. Initiating a chargeback for a charge that is valid under these terms may, at our discretion, result in suspension of services, recovery of associated chargeback fees, and disclosure of relevant transaction records to the card networks and issuing bank as part of the dispute process.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subTitle: Privacy Policy
privacy.description1: This Privacy Policy is issued by Devora Systems, doing business as Devora ('we,' 'our,' or 'us'), a company organized under the laws of the State of New Mexico, United States, with its principal place of business at 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE, STE R, Albuquerque, NM 87110, USA. It explains how we collect, use, store, and share personal data when you visit our website or purchase our WordPress maintenance, security, and SEO services. We act as the data controller of the personal data described below. By using our website or services you confirm that you have read this policy.
privacy.description2: 1. Data we collect. Identity and contact data: name, business name, email address, billing address, and telephone number you provide when creating an account, requesting a quote, or contacting support. Transaction data: products purchased, invoice number, amount, currency, and date. Technical data: IP address, browser type and version, time zone, operating system, and pages visited, collected through cookies and similar technologies. Service data: WordPress login credentials, hosting access, and site configuration information you choose to share so that we can deliver the services.
privacy.description3: 2. Payment data. We do not store full payment card numbers, CVV codes, or bank account numbers on our servers. All card and bank payments are processed by Stripe, Inc. and its affiliates ('Stripe'), which is certified as a PCI Service Provider Level 1 under the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS). When you pay, your card details are submitted directly to Stripe over TLS and we receive only a tokenized reference, the last four digits of the card, the card brand, the expiry month and year, the cardholder name, and the country of issuance. Stripe's own privacy notice applies to the data Stripe collects and is available at https://stripe.com/privacy.
privacy.description5: We process personal data on the following legal bases: (a) performance of a contract, to deliver the services you have ordered, manage your account, send invoices, and provide customer support; (b) legal obligation, including tax, accounting, anti-fraud, anti-money-laundering, and record-keeping requirements; (c) legitimate interests, to operate, secure, and improve our services and to communicate with existing customers about similar services; and (d) consent, for optional marketing communications and non-essential cookies, which you can withdraw at any time.
privacy.description6: 4. Payment processing, fraud prevention, and chargebacks. Stripe is our sole payment processor. Stripe may use the transaction and device information you provide to detect and prevent fraud, perform sanctions and watch-list screening (including OFAC), and meet Strong Customer Authentication requirements where applicable. We may share limited information with Stripe and, through Stripe, with the card networks (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover) and the issuing bank as needed to authorize a payment, process a refund, or respond to a chargeback, retrieval, or pre-arbitration request. We retain payment-related records for the period required by applicable tax and anti-money-laundering law.
privacy.description7: 5. Cookies. We use a small number of essential cookies to keep the site functional and to remember your preferences. Analytics and marketing cookies, where used, are only loaded after you accept them in the cookie banner. You can clear or block cookies at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.description8: 6. Marketing communications. We will only send you marketing email if you have opted in or are an existing customer receiving information about similar services. Every marketing email contains an unsubscribe link. Unsubscribing does not affect transactional emails such as invoices, renewal notices, or service alerts.
privacy.description10: We apply administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect personal data, including TLS encryption in transit, encryption at rest for credentials, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication for staff accounts, regular backups, and least-privilege access to customer environments. No system can be guaranteed to be 100% secure; we will notify affected users and the competent supervisory authority of any personal data breach as required by law.
privacy.description12: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the following categories of recipients and only to the extent necessary:
privacy.description13: Service providers acting as processors on our behalf, including Stripe (payments), our hosting and email providers, our accounting and invoicing software, and our customer support tooling. All processors are bound by written agreements and may only use your data on our documented instructions.
privacy.description14: Authorities and regulators, where we are required by law to disclose information, including in response to a valid court order, tax investigation, anti-money-laundering enquiry, or law enforcement request.
privacy.description15: Successors in interest, in the event of a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or sale of assets. We will notify you in advance and ensure that any successor is bound by privacy commitments at least as protective as those in this policy.
privacy.description17: Subject to applicable law, you have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to request rectification or erasure, to restrict or object to processing, to portability, and to withdraw any consent you have given. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. To exercise any of these rights please email contact@devorasystems.com; we will respond within 30 days.
privacy.description18: 10. International transfers and retention. Devora Systems is established in the United States. Where personal data of users located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland is transferred to the United States or other jurisdictions, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, the UK International Data Transfer Addendum, or another lawful transfer mechanism, and we apply supplementary safeguards where required. We retain personal data only for as long as needed to deliver the services and to meet our legal obligations: account and transaction records are kept for the period required by applicable tax, accounting, and anti-money-laundering law (typically up to 7 years), and support correspondence is kept for up to 3 years after closure of the ticket.
privacy.description20: Our services are intended for businesses and adults aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided personal data to us, please contact us so we can delete it.
privacy.description22: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or in the law. The current version, together with the date it was last updated, will always be published on this page. Material changes will be communicated to active customers by email at least 14 days before they take effect. Questions about this policy or about how we handle personal data can be sent to contact@devorasystems.com or by post to Devora Systems, 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE, STE R, Albuquerque, NM 87110, United States. California residents have additional rights under the CCPA/CPRA, including the right to know, the right to delete, the right to correct, and the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information; we do not sell personal information.
